besluite.fout: The same buildings are called 'hierdie geboue' and then 'daardie geboue' two sentences later, so a reader can wonder whether a different group is meant.
besluite.rede: Keeping 'hierdie' holds one reference for the same buildings, avoids a second 'daardie' straight after 'Daardie werk', and adds no words without moving the meaning.

'kry steiler dakke' is natural Afrikaans and carries the sense that builders give these buildings steeper roofs because of the rain, which fits the paragraph's cause-and-design point; 'het' turns it into a static description, so it is at best a lateral move.
